out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Age 11: terror at not breathing; then acceptance/relaxation and heightened beauty of nature. Age 24: 'flung... out of my body' with increasing love. Age 11 also reports floating upward through atmospheric layers.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: A 'cool gray fog' enveloped him and 'swirled into a tunnel of light, taking me upward into the heavens.'

arrival.other_being_detail: Seven 'beings of light' described as 'seven faces of God' (one yet seven). Also 'dark great grandmother and dark great grandfather' in the hell/Pit experience; mentions 'two bees' at eye level at return from the Pit.

environment.environment_other_detail: Pastoral landscapes; huge alabaster temple/cathedral on a mountain with archways, pillars, vaulted dome glowing from within; a chamber where 'people... asleep on earth yet learning here'; and a hell/Pit with a cold steel bridge suspended above it; also a 'cool gray fog.'

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Angels taught him and showed him future events; later 'came to me in the next three years... each with a specific task' and taught connection/preciousness of life and generating love.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Three episodes described: (1) age 11 fall from swing set with inability to breathe; (2) age 24 motorcycle head-on collision with broken back; (3) 1987 fever/illness with passing out and 'borderline coma' leading to hell/Pit experience.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Hell/Pit episode with 'dark great grandmother and dark great grandfather', being 'stripped naked', and 'demons clinging' on return; also panoramic visions of past (age 11) and future prophecy (age 24).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Age 11: heightened nature/past visions then floating upward and loving voice then abrupt return. Age 24: OBE -> gray fog -> tunnel of light -> heavenly temple -> beings of light/telepathic teaching/visions -> gray fog -> immediate awakening in ambulance (no tunnel on return). Age 1987: wakes 'dead' in hell/Pit (entry sequence not described).
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Multiple NDEs with recurring love/voice and later repeated post-NDE visits by beings of light in dreams/visions.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: During the seven beings' communication, 'pictures... in my head' filled the room and he was 'in the picture' while receiving telepathic teaching.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Age 11: perceives 'the last 400 years' rising 'out of the ground' and becomes 'the nose of an old Native American' with heightened smell; age 24: 'HUUU' cosmic hum/voice like thunder/airplanes; prophecy of U.S. president with 'R.R.'; 1987: hell/Pit initiation with dark great grandparents, stripping naked, demons clinging; extensive post-NDE claims of telepathy, electrical effects, healing, heart-rate control, theta state, and IQ increase.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "A cool gray fog enveloped me and swirled into a tunnel of light, taking me upward into the heavens."; "In this light were seven beings of light... They were one, yet seven."; "He will become the president of the United States."; "Then, I woke up dead."; "You are stripped totally naked there. No protection whatsoever. Nada."; "I was going home!"
